cues: A plant is resistant when it can stop or limit infection.
Vertical resistance comes from one or a few major genes.
It gives complete protection, but only against some races of the pathogen, and it breaks down when a new race appears.
Horizontal resistance comes from many small genes: only partial, but against every race, and it lasts.
